# Madison Business Center

> Offices for rent at 5345 Madison Ave in Sacramento. The smallest one is $500 a month, with a one-year lease. The building is gated, with 24/7 access. Call 916-914-4407.

- Address: 5345 Madison Ave, Sacramento, CA 95841
- Phone and WhatsApp: 916-914-4407
- Smallest office: $500 a month, one-year lease, deposit equal to one month's rent
- Gated parking lot, 24/7 access, video surveillance, conference room for tenants
- Languages on the site: English, Spanish, Russian (https://5345madisonave.com/?lang=en, ?lang=es, ?lang=ru)
